prayerExcerpt.en-US: Lord, do not hold this sin against them.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Senhor, não lhes leveis em conta este pecado.

meta.face: A beardless youth around 20, completely clean-shaven, short light-brown hair with a small clerical tonsure, a serene radiant almost angelic expression.
meta.basis: Beardless youth with a tonsure (Painter's Manual); an angel's face (Acts 6:15).

sources.title: Dionysius of Fourna, The Painter's Manual (Hermeneia), c. 1730 — Didron's 1845 French edition

history.note: Face edited to separate him from Lawrence
